atoms.b: Schools emphasise academic achievement as the primary goal. ((++Nevertheless In_spite_of While)), research increasingly shows that emotional intelligence and mental health are equally important for personal development.
Solar panels are expensive to install. ((++However In_Contrast Unlike)), many homeowners consider them a worthwhile long-term investment because of reduced electricity bills.
Social media enables global connection and community building. ((++On_the_other_hand Regardless_of Apart_from)), it exposes users to cyberbullying, misinformation, and manipulative algorithms.
Recycling is important for the environment, ((++but instead regardless_of)) most people still don't separate their waste properly.
((++Despite Even_though Still)) the increased awareness about climate change, many industries continue to prioritise profit over environmental protection.
Rather than complaining about the problem, we should work together to find solutions. ((++Instead Apart_from Even_though)), most people blame others without taking responsibility.
((++Although Apart_from Yet)) many people are aware of climate change, they continue using plastic bags without guilt.

Fast fashion is supposed to be a solution for affordable clothing access. ((++On_the_contrary Unlike While)), it creates massive waste, environmental damage, and supports exploitative labour practices.

atoms.b: Women have made significant progress in education and professional achievement. ((++In_spite_of)) these advances, the gender pay gap persists in nearly every industry and country. In some fields, women earn 20-30% less than men for identical work. ((++Yet)), legislation protecting equal pay exists in most countries. The causes of the gap are complex and multifaceted. ((++In_contrast_to)) the stereotype that they are less committed to careers, research shows women are equally ambitious and productive.

“In spite of” signals that something unexpected or surprising has happened.
“In contrast to” highlights a difference between two things.

atoms.b: Video games are often criticized as a waste of time that distracts from academic work. ((++Nonetheless)), research increasingly shows that certain games develop problem-solving skills and strategic thinking. ((++While ++Even_though)) traditional education focuses on memorisation and standardised testing, games encourage experimentation and creativity. ((++Even_though ++While)) educational games exist, most teenagers prefer entertainment-focused games for leisure. ((++Unlike)) popular stereotypes that portray gamers as isolated individuals, many modern games emphasise collaboration and teamwork.

atoms.b: Online shopping has revolutionised consumer behaviour and convenience. ((++Whereas)) in-store shopping requires visiting physical stores, online platforms allow customers to purchase from their home in seconds. Lots of companies promote online shopping as a money-saving solution. ((++Still)), many people have become addicted, which leads to excessive spending and impulse buying. ((++Apart_from)) environmental benefits of reducing traffic to visit stores, online shopping creates massive waste through packaging and returns. ((++Regardless_of)) efforts to promote sustainable packaging, most companies continue to use excessive plastic wrapping.
